facts.value: The central study advising supports you competently with all concerns related to studying.
The student secretariat is your reliable contact for all questions regarding the organization of your studies.
In the examination offices, you will find contacts for all formal matters regarding your academic achievements.
Goethe University supports international students with comprehensive advisory and service offers from application to graduation.

The PBS offers you support and a listening ear for personal concerns, providing individual discussions, online lectures, and workshops on topics such as self-reflection, resilience, and stress management each semester.

The PSB supports students with personal and study-related challenges, such as anxiety, loneliness, relational stress, or learning blocks, offering individual, couple consultations, and group offerings.

In addition to a variety of sports offerings, university sports also offers courses and videos for stress management and self-assertion, as well as events to actively get involved and make new contacts.

The Career Service supports students and alumni (up to one year after graduation) in starting their careers, strengthening career competence through workshops, coaching, and networks. Free, practical, and individual – your springboard into the job.
Goethe University promotes an equitable and discrimination-sensitive environment and stands for equality, diversity, and inclusion.
Advisory services in discrimination cases as well as measures for the prevention and reduction of discrimination are available.
The ombudspersons are your contacts for problems, complaints, or suggestions for improvement regarding studies and promotions.
The scholarship service supports students and staff from all disciplines. Find your scholarship and benefit from individual advice!
The Student Union offers affordable housing near campus. Explore various dormitories, check rental prices, and apply online for your room.
BAföG, scholarships, part-time jobs, or loans – the Student Union Frankfurt informs about all options for study financing and offers individual advice.
